name: Jordynne Grace
description:
Jordynne Grace is a modern-day juggernaut – a walking combination of brute strength, unmatched conditioning, and unshakable confidence. She didn’t ask for respect in the wrestling world – she took it. With a body sculpted like a tank and a mind as sharp as a tack, Jordynne has bulldozed her way through some of the toughest competition on the planet, becoming a multi-time Knockouts Champion and one of the most dominant forces in wrestling today.

Nicknamed the “Juggernaut,” Jordynne exploded onto the scene with feats of power rarely seen in women’s wrestling – tossing opponents across the ring, deadlifting them into the sky, and still having the cardio to go the distance. Her matches aren’t just contests – they’re battles. Her reigns aren’t just titles – they’re statements. She made history by stepping into intergender matches and proving, time and time again, that gender is no barrier when you’re that good.

But Jordynne Grace is more than just muscle. She’s discipline. She’s drive. She’s evolution. Outside the ring, she’s a symbol of self-made greatness – redefining body image in wrestling and inspiring countless others to embrace their strength and forge their own path.

Now, in a time far beyond the one she ruled, the Juggernaut awakens once more. The stage is bigger, the opponents are tougher, but so is she.

“I didn’t come here to play nice. I came here to lift this entire world on my shoulders – and slam it down.”

name: Taya Valkyrie
description:
Taya Valkyrie is wrestling royalty — the self-proclaimed “La Wera Loca,” the longest-reigning Knockouts Champion in history, and a globe-trotting queen who has conquered every kingdom she’s entered. With a background in lucha libre and a flair for the dramatic, Taya blends ruthless aggression with elegant execution like no one else in the game.

Trained in the heart of Mexico, she earned her stripes in the trenches of AAA, becoming the first foreign-born Reina de Reinas Champion. From there, she stormed the North American scene, collecting championships and breaking records wherever she went — including a legendary run in Impact Wrestling that solidified her as one of the most decorated women's wrestlers of her era.

But make no mistake — behind the fur coats, diamonds, and crowns is a fighter who’s paid her dues in blood, sweat, and shattered bones. Taya’s offense is as vicious as her attitude — suplexes with snap, knees with venom, and a Road to Valhalla that leaves no one standing. She's as cunning as she is dangerous, and once she smells weakness, it's already too late.

Now, centuries into the future, the Queen has returned — not to reclaim her throne, but to build a new empire… on top of the ashes of her rivals.

“Bow down — or be broken. Those are your only two options when you're in my ring.”

abilities.name: Loca
abilities.description: Whenever you successfully execute a combo using two different ATTACK categories, you may either deal -2 [[health]] extra or gain +2 [[momentum]] extra.

abilities.name: All Rounder
abilities.description: Trigger when defending against a 3+ damage attack. Discard 1 [[card]] matching the opponent's ATTACK category to gain the initiative. Can be used twice.

abilities.name: Vicious
abilities.description: After a successful Strike or Throw attack, spend -1 [[stamina]] to deal an additional -2 [[health]]. Can be used once.

name: Cassie Lee
description:
Cassie Lee is the embodiment of confidence, beauty and chaos – a magnetic force who danced her way into the spotlight and owned it like she was born there. With a killer instinct and deadly strikes masked by a dazzling smile, Cassie is a one-woman highlight reel, equal parts glam and grit, and a master of mind games and in-ring mayhem.

Hailing from Sydney, Australia, Cassie climbed the ranks with charm, wit, and a spinning heel kick that came from nowhere and landed everywhere. As one half of one of the most entertaining and decorated women’s tag teams of the modern era, she became known for stealing scenes, starting trends, and snatching titles. But don’t let the flawless fashion and iconic poses distract you – when the bell rings, Cassie Lee is all business.

Her style is fast, fierce, and unpredictable – a mix of technical precision and pure Aussie fire. She’s not just a performer; she’s a presence. From comedy gold to championship gold, she’s done it all – and looked amazing doing it.

Now, centuries beyond her time, Cassie Lee returns to a new era of combat – and she’s still stealing the show, breaking hearts, and kicking heads.

“Darling, I didn’t come back to play fair. I came to win, pose, and be absolutely iconic – in that order.”

abilities.name: Inspirational
abilities.description: When Taunting, gain an additional +1 [[momentum]]. If your [[momentum]] is 5 or higher, you may instead gain -1 target roll on your next attack.

abilities.name: Inspirational Cheat
abilities.description: Spend -1 [[stamina]]. Gain the initiative. Deal -1 damage to the opponent.

abilities.name: Nose Job
abilities.description: After any successful KICK or KNEE attack, roll 1 die and deal damage equal to half the roll rounded down.

name: Jessie McKay
description:
Jessie McKay is charisma in overdrive — a bold, brash, and beautiful Aussie export who took the wrestling world by storm with her wit, her kicks, and her undeniable star power. Whether she was dazzling in tag team gold or lighting up arenas with her infectious energy, Jessie McKay proved one thing every time she stepped through the ropes: she belongs on center stage.

Breaking out of Australia and making her name across the globe, Jessie was hated at first, then became a fan favorite for her larger-than-life personality and her sharp in-ring skills. But don't let the charm fool you — beneath the glamour and the poses is a deadly striker with picture-perfect precision. Her signature big boot comes out of nowhere and shuts the lights out fast. She didn't just look the part — she kicked it into reality.

Now, revived in a future where style and substance reign supreme, Jessie McKay is back — shinier, sharper, and more dangerous than ever.

"Lights. Camera. Kick to the face. That's how I roll. And sweetie, I always hit my mark."

name: Abilene Maverick
description:
Abilene Maverick is sugar, spice, and nothing nice. Don’t let the Southern drawl and designer boots fool you – the “Governor’s Daughter” is as ruthless as they come. With a dazzling smile and a dangerous streak, Abilene has charmed, cheated, and clawed her way to the top of the WOW Women of Wrestling scene – and she plans to do the same here, no matter what century it is.

The former WOW Champion was raised to believe she was born for greatness. Abilene carries herself with an air of entitlement – and backs it up with a vicious streak a mile wide. Her wrestling style is deceptively elegant: smooth chain wrestling, sharp kicks, and most importantly, filled with underhanded tactics that always seem to go unnoticed by the ref. She doesn’t play fair – she plays to win.

Whether she’s cutting a promo or cutting corners, Abilene is always in control. And if things don’t go her way? Well, just ask her former friends and tag partners what happens when you cross her – but maybe don’t do it in front of her. She’s got a reputation to uphold, after all.

Now, in a future far from the luxury she’s used to, Abilene Maverick finds herself surrounded by chaos. But don’t worry – she’s here to bring class back to combat… and leave everyone else crying in the dust.

“Bless your heart… if you think you belong in the same ring as me.”

abilities.name: Grab The Tights
abilities.description: After triggering a [[pin]], spend -2 [[stamina]]. Your opponent adds 1 to the total of each kickout roll (2 dice must beat current HP — higher total makes it harder to kick out).

abilities.name: Eye Poke
abilities.description: Gain the initiative. Your opponent cannot defend against your next attack.

abilities.name: Behind The Ref
abilities.description: After a successful GRAPPLE, spend -1 [[stamina]] to deal -1 [[health]] to opponent and gain +1 [[stamina]].

name: The Beast
description:
The Beast isn’t just a wrestler — she’s a living, breathing nightmare. An unstoppable force from the WOW Women of Wrestling universe, The Beast dominates with terrifying presence, brute strength, and an aura so intense it sends chills down the spines of even the bravest competitors. When she steps into the ring, there’s no music. No smile. No games. Just destruction.

Crowned the WOW World Champion after plowing through the roster like a wrecking ball, The Beast earned her title with sheer dominance — overpowering, outlasting, and outright obliterating anyone who dared stand across from her. Her physique is carved from powerlifting steel, her stare is ice cold, and her moves hit like a freight train. There are no wasted motions — only pain. Her powerbomb? It doesn’t just end matches. It ends hope.

She doesn’t talk much. She doesn’t need to. Her silence speaks louder than most rosters combined. She doesn’t care about fame or adoration — only the fight. And if you want to survive against The Beast, you better be faster, smarter, and stronger than you’ve ever been in your life. Spoiler alert: you’re not.

Now, centuries into a future ravaged by chaos, The Beast walks again — from the darkest depths of your mind. She’s not here to entertain. She’s here to destroy.

You don’t beat The Beast. You survive her… if you’re lucky.

abilities.name: Beast Rage
abilities.description: Whenever you deal or suffer 2 or more damage in a single hit, gain 1 Rage Token.

abilities.name: Beast Power
abilities.description: After a successful STRIKE or THROW, spend Rage Tokens for bonus damage and [[momentum]]. 2 tokens: deal -1, gain +1 [[momentum]]. 4 tokens: deal -2, gain +2 [[momentum]]. 6 tokens: deal -4, gain +2 [[momentum]]. Player chooses tier.

abilities.name: Unbeatable
abilities.description: Spend 4 Rage Tokens. Gain +2 [[health]] and +1 kickout roll.

name: Tormenta
description:
Tormenta is the storm that can’t be stopped – a high-flying, hard-hitting luchadora who brings the fury of the skies with every move she makes. Born from the traditions of Mexican wrestling and forged through a relentless drive to rise, Tormenta is a force of speed, spirit, and strength.

Masked and mysterious, Tormenta struck the WOW Women of Wrestling scene like a bolt of lightning – electrifying fans with her aerial offense and brutal power. Whether she’s soaring from the top rope or trading blows with bigger opponents, she is a force to be reckoned with, a face that allowed her to become the first ever Latina WOW Champion.

Now, far beyond her own time, Tormenta has entered a world where only the best survive. Lucky for her… the storm never dies.

“They called me a storm. Now they’ll call me champion again.”

abilities.name: Lucha Champion
abilities.description: After each successful Aerial attack, gain 1 Lucha Token.

abilities.name: Lucha Power
abilities.description: Discard a Strike or Throw [[card]] to deal an additional -2 [[health]] after a successful Strike. Can be used once.

abilities.name: Lucha Legend
abilities.description: After a successful attack, spend 1 Lucha Token to gain +1 [[momentum]]. When defending, spend 3 Lucha Tokens to block attacks dealing -3 [[health]] or less and gain the initiative.
abilities.effectScript: if (event == 'ATTACK_SUCCESS' && wrestler.abilityTokens['Lucha'] >= 1) { wrestler.abilityTokens['Lucha'] -= 1; wrestler.momentum += 1 } if (event == 'ATTACK_INCOMING' && match.incomingDamage <= 3 && wrestler.abilityTokens['Lucha'] >= 3) { wrestler.abilityTokens['Lucha'] -= 3; blockAttack(); wrestler.gainInitiative() }

name: Princess Aussie
description:
Princess Aussie is more than just a competitor – she’s a symbol of fire, resilience, and charisma. A former WOW World Champion, she was also the People’s Champion – fierce in combat, fearless in adversity, and impossible to keep down.

Armed with athleticism, technique, agility, and raw emotion, Princess Aussie made an immediate impact with her dynamic style and underdog heart. She can throw, grapple, counter, or fly across the ring, a fact that makes her difficult to beat. Her offense is sharp, fast, and explosive – and she can counter almost any move with her Cutter From Down Under.

Now, reborn in a future where only the bold survive, Princess Aussie carries the hopes of a new generation. She’s not here to dominate with fear – she’s here to inspire through battle.

“I fight with pride, I rise with purpose – and I never stay down.”

abilities.name: Reversal
abilities.description: Spend -1 [[stamina]] to gain the initiative, deal -1 [[health]] to opponent, and gain +1 [[momentum]].

abilities.name: Fan Favorite
abilities.description: Aerial attacks gain +1 [[momentum]] when you or your opponent are on a winning streak. [[signature]] and [[finisher]] attacks always gain +2 [[momentum]].
abilities.effectScript: if (match.attackCardType == 'AERIAL' && (wrestler.onAWinningStreak || opponent.onAWinningStreak)) { wrestler.momentum += 1 } if (match.attackCardType == 'SIGNATURE' || match.attackCardType == 'FINISHER') { wrestler.momentum += 2 }

abilities.name: Aussie Wrestling
abilities.description: Discard a Grapple [[card]] to block a Grapple attack of 3 or less damage. Gain the initiative. Can be used once.

abilities.name: Cutter From Down Under
abilities.description: Discard a Cutter [[card]] to block any attack and gain the initiative. Resolve the discarded card with -1 to the opponent's next attack roll target. Can be used once.
